conflicts.permit: For users who identify themselves as children in our age-gate on such Services, if we allow children to use the Services, we will either provide a version of that Service that does not collect, use, or disclose “personal information” (as defined in the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (“COPPA”)), except as permitted by COPPA or other privacy laws (where applicable), or obtain legally valid parental consent.
conflicts.prohibit: Children are not permitted to use these Services, and we do not knowingly collect any personal information from children.
conflicts.situation: A user identifies as a child in the age gate, Zynga lets the child use the Service, obtains parental consent, and collects the child's personal information.
conflicts.reason: The prohibition is categorical and states no exception for parental consent, while the later sentence permits use by children and collection with parental consent. The policy does not say which statement governs.

conflicts.permit: We’ll also keep information in order to exercise, protect, defend, or establish our rights or the rights of third parties.
conflicts.prohibit: we will not retain your personal information for longer than is necessary for to provide you with the Services or for our legal requirements.
conflicts.situation: After a user deletes the account, Zynga keeps the user's information only to establish or defend its own rights or rights of third parties, with no legal requirement to keep it.
conflicts.reason: The retention limit names only service provision and legal requirements. The deletion section keeps data to protect rights of Zynga or third parties. The policy does not say which statement governs.

conflicts.permit: We may share information about you with service providers who perform services on our behalf.
conflicts.prohibit: None of the data collected by us is shared with 3rd parties, business partners or even advertisers.
conflicts.situation: Global Delight shares Vizmato usage data with an analytics platform or measurement partner acting as its service provider.
conflicts.reason: The policy states that no data is shared with third parties, then lists service providers under the heading of third parties it shares with. No exception or precedence reconciles the two.

conflicts.permit: we may share your information with that company before and after the transaction closes.
conflicts.prohibit: None of the data collected by us is shared with 3rd parties, business partners or even advertisers.
conflicts.situation: Global Delight is acquired by another company and shares Vizmato user information with the acquirer before the transaction closes.
conflicts.reason: The acquiring company is a third party, and the categorical statement that no data is shared with third parties states no exception for mergers or acquisitions.

conflicts.permit: Your IP address is also used to help identify you and to gather broad demographic information to customize your experience on Website and/or the Mobile App.
conflicts.prohibit: Unless you voluntarily identify yourself (through registration, for example), we would not know who you are, even if we assign a cookie to your device.
conflicts.situation: An unregistered visitor browses the Momspresso website, and Momspresso processes the visitor's IP address.
conflicts.reason: One statement uses the IP address to help identify the user, while the other says an unregistered user is not known. The policy does not define identification or say which statement governs.
